verdict.rationale: The open-source Orama JS library lets an agent do the whole lifecycle in code: create a database with a schema, insert documents (including `insertMultiple` batches), and run full-text, vector or hybrid search. Orama Cloud is weaker for agents: its per-project MCP server is documented only for interacting with existing data, and the Cloud REST APIs are private, so creating indexes and loading documents headlessly in Cloud rests only on SDK mentions. missing for 10: documented index creation and document ingestion via MCP, public Cloud REST/OpenAPI reference, an official CLI, and evidence that Cloud project and data-source setup needs no dashboard.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can create an index, add documents, and run queries end to end — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: We can create a new instance (from now on database) with an **indexing `schema`**.
If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the `insertMultiple` function
Hybrid search is an Orama feature that allows you to perform full-text and vector search in one unique query
Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
